about: Every Logbook column's order, both ways: the one table the engine (src-tauri log_queries tests) and the reference (ui logQuery.test.ts) are both held to. Each case's rows are whole LoggedQso rows.

cases.name: upLotw: a duplicate is done, an auth failure failed
exchSent: an empty slot is skipped, then the ADIF string, then the serial alone
notes: a blank comment falls through to the private note
notes: the first 64 characters order it, a tie past them keeps the time order
distance: a value that is not a number after the numbers, before the empty, both ways
distance: a 0x value is not a number
ituz: a 0o value is not a number
cqz: a 0B value is not a number
distance: values that are not numbers order among themselves without regard to case
an upload mark as the second key, the continent tying
mode: a blank mode is empty, last both ways; EEE is FT8
sent: a value is read trimmed, a blank one is empty
exchSent: serials by number, 9 before 10 before 100
exchSent: a leading zero does not count
exchRcvd: a number by value inside text, capitals ignored, a number before the letters
exchRcvd: a number, then the text after it
